description: Search handyai.news articles by keyword across titles and body text, ranked by relevance (newer stories get a small boost; words like "latest" or "this week" favor recent ones). Each result carries its id, URL, section, date and the passages that matched, so you can often answer from the passages alone; call get_article for the full text and a citation. Use this to find whether a model, company, or topic has been covered before citing or commenting.

query.description: Keywords: company, model, product or topic names. Case-insensitive.

name: search_articles
title: Search articles
